Sub Class_Globals
	Public AlertDanger As String
	Public AlertDark As String
	Public AlertInfo As String
	Public AlertLight As String
	Public AlertPrimary As String
	Public AlertSecondary As String
	Public AlertSuccess As String
	Public AlertWarning As String
End Sub
Sub Initialize
	AlertDanger = "alert-danger"
	AlertDark = "alert-dark"
	AlertInfo = "alert-info"
	AlertLight = "alert-light"
	AlertPrimary = "alert-primary"
	AlertSecondary = "alert-secondary"
	AlertSuccess = "alert-success"
	AlertWarning = "alert-warning"
End Sub
Sub SetAlertColor(el as HTMLElement, varClass As String) As HTMLElement
	el.RemoveClass("alert-danger")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-dark")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-info")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-light")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-primary")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-secondary")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-success")
	el.RemoveClass("alert-warning")
	el.AddClass(varClass)
	Return el
End Sub
